features.title: Evidence-backed release lifecycle and state machine
acceptance: Create release drafts, record criteria with evidence and owners, enforce passing reviews for required criteria, and freeze approved evidence.

features.title: Independent revision-bound approvals and blocker resolution
acceptance: Track blockers with severity and auto-categorization; reject approval by release creator; tie approval decisions strictly to current evidence revision.

features.title: Deterministic risk scoring, evaluation diagnostics, and audit export
acceptance: Calculate deterministic risk index with feature weights and NLP classification; export release notes in JSON/Markdown/CSV; provide reproducible evaluation corpus.

features.title: Interactive release search and lifecycle status filtering
acceptance: Filter releases by lifecycle status (draft, in_review, approved, released, cancelled) and search by keyword across name and description with filter-aware pagination and empty states in both API and UI.

features.title: In-app structured release notes preview modal
acceptance: Preview generated release notes directly in the UI before exporting or releasing.
